output_list.criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is added to the balanceOf[target] without a check, allowing the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user's balance to any arbitrary value.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; can overflow if balanceOf[_to] is at maximum uint256, causing a buyout attack.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; can overflow if balanceOf[_to] is at maximum uint256, causing a buyout attack.
The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount is calculated by dividing the msg.value by buyPrice, buyPrice can be set to a very large value, causing an overflow.
The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount is multiplied by sellPrice, sellPrice can be set to a very large value, causing an overflow.
